title: Rencontres numbers: exactly r fixed points
content: The docstring states the target: for a finite type $\alpha$ with $|\alpha| = n$ and any $r$, the number of permutations of $\alpha$ with *exactly* $r$ fixed points is $\binom{n}{r} D(n-r)$, where $D = \texttt{numDerangements}$. This is the per-cardinality refinement of the parent entry $\texttt{derangements-convergence-oq-07}$, which proves only the summed identity $n! = \sum_{k} \binom{n}{k} D(n-k)$; each summand is isolated here as an honest cardinality. The plan is two steps — a fiber lemma counting permutations with a *prescribed* fixed-point set, then aggregation over the $\binom{n}{r}$ size-$r$ subsets. Imports the two Mathlib derangement modules (supplying $\texttt{derangements.subtypeEquiv}$ and $\texttt{card\_derangements\_eq\_numDerangements}$) and $\texttt{Mathlib.Tactic}$.
mathContext: $\#\{\sigma \in S_\alpha : \#\mathrm{Fix}(\sigma) = r\} = \binom{n}{r} D(n-r)$, the rencontres number $D_{n,r}$.

title: Fiber lemma: fixed-point set exactly S
content:
`card_fixedPointFinset_fiber` counts the permutations $\sigma$ whose fixed-point finset $\{x : \sigma x = x\}$ equals a prescribed set $S$: there are exactly $D(|\alpha| - |S|)$ of them. A permutation fixing exactly $S$ is fixed-point-free on the complement of $S$, i.e. it restricts to a derangement of a set of size $|\alpha| - |S|$. The Lean proof rewrites the filter cardinality as $	exttt{Fintype.card}$ of a subtype, transports it along $	exttt{Equiv.subtypeEquivRight}$ to the predicate form $( orall a,\ 
eg(a 
otin S) \leftrightarrow a \in \mathrm{fixedPoints}\ \sigma)$ — the double-negation bridge $
eg(a 
otin S) \leftrightarrow a \in S$ handled by a pointwise $	exttt{Finset.ext}$ — then applies $	exttt{derangements.subtypeEquiv}\ (\cdot 
otin S)$, $	exttt{card\_derangements\_eq\_numDerangements}$, and $	exttt{Fintype.card\_subtype\_compl}$. Reproved self-containedly to match the parent's lemma.

title: Aggregation over the size-r fixed-point sets
content: `card_perm_fixedPoints_card_eq` is the headline result: $\#\{\sigma : (\mathrm{Fix}\ \sigma).\mathrm{card} = r\} = \binom{|\alpha|}{r} D(|\alpha| - r)$. The permutations with $r$ fixed points are partitioned by their fixed-point set via $\texttt{Finset.card\_eq\_sum\_card\_fiberwise}$; since a permutation with $r$ fixed points has a size-$r$ fixed-point set, the fibering map lands in $\texttt{powersetCard}\ r\ \texttt{univ}$. The crux is a redundancy step: on a fixed size-$r$ set $S$, the outer constraint $(\mathrm{Fix}\ \sigma).\mathrm{card} = r$ is automatic once $\mathrm{Fix}\ \sigma = S$, so the restricted fiber equals the plain fiber (a short $\texttt{Finset.ext}$), letting $\texttt{card\_fixedPointFinset\_fiber}$ supply the constant value $D(|\alpha| - r)$. Finally $\texttt{Finset.sum\_const}$ and $\texttt{Finset.card\_powersetCard}$ turn $\sum_{|S|=r} D(|\alpha|-r)$ into $\binom{|\alpha|}{r} \cdot D(|\alpha|-r)$.
mathContext: $\#\{\sigma : \#\mathrm{Fix}(\sigma) = r\} = \sum_{|S| = r} D(n - r) = \binom{n}{r} D(n - r)$.

title: Specialization to Fin n
content: `card_perm_fixedPoints_card_eq_fin` reads the general finite-type statement off at $\alpha = \mathrm{Fin}\ n$: the number of permutations of an $n$-element set with exactly $r$ fixed points is $\binom{n}{r} D(n-r)$. The proof instantiates the general theorem and rewrites $\texttt{Fintype.card (Fin n)} = n$ via $\texttt{Fintype.card\_fin}$ with a single $\texttt{simpa}$.

title: Concrete sanity checks (decide)
content: Two $\texttt{decide}$-checked examples exercise the count at both a nonzero $r$ and the $r = 0$ boundary. On $\mathrm{Fin}\ 3$ there are $\binom{3}{1} D(2) = 3 \cdot 1 = 3$ permutations with exactly one fixed point — the three transpositions. On $\mathrm{Fin}\ 4$ there are $\binom{4}{0} D(4) = 1 \cdot 9 = 9$ permutations with no fixed points — the derangements of four elements. After rewriting by $\texttt{card\_perm\_fixedPoints\_card\_eq\_fin}$, both reduce to concrete $\mathbb{N}$ equalities discharged by kernel reduction, adding no axioms.
